title: A numbered list
concept: Three paragraphs numbered 1–3 by list attributes on their paragraph range: the numbers are generated, not stored in Content.

annotations.note: BulletsAndNumberingListType=NumberedList turns numbering on. NumberingExpression ^#.^t writes the number (^#), a full stop and a tab (^t). LeftIndent 18 with FirstLineIndent -18 hangs the number in the indent, so the tab lands on the text edge.
NumberingFormat is a typed Properties child, the only spelling InDesign reads: "1, 2, 3, 4..." is arabic numerals.

The Content holds only the item text. Each
ends a list item; the numbers 1, 2 and 3 are generated at layout time.
